resolution.source_excerpt: Armed with the knowledge from the stone circle in the highlands of Pictavia, you finally understand the ancient markings.

resolution.source_excerpt: Through tremendous effort, the Northman raises himself unto his elbows.

resolution.source_excerpt: Turn around while you still can, Viking!

terms.source: Slainte mhor a h-uile la a chi 's nach fhaic!

resolution.source_excerpt: outside the northern gate of Legacæstir

resolution.source_excerpt: We have shrines to Odinn, Thorr, and Freyja here, but I am happy to accept offerings for any Æsir or Vanir you wish to appease.

resolution.source_excerpt: This severed horn of an aurochs

terms.note: 本作维京语境中指北欧人群；此处可能泛指北方战士。

resolution.source_excerpt: Valhøll

resolution.source_excerpt: Defeat the surviving Norwegian raiders.

resolution.reason: 本条的 thegn of the Visundr 后接其整个氏族迁居的计划，Visundr 在此指氏族，译为“维松德氏族”准确。其他记录的 crew of / took off 语境明确指船只，应将同名船只与氏族区分。

resolution.source_excerpt: Pushes the target 1 hex away and applies the status effect [StatusEffect].

resolution.reason: longship 在此指可供航行的长船；“长船”已表达词义，不必添加原文没有的“维京”限定，采用该批既有译名并统一其单数条目。
resolution.source_excerpt: I'll move my possessions to your magnificent longship.

resolution.reason: 在英国积累并吸引战士、用于向外扩张的 Power 指政治军事势力，可译“势力”；说明界面明确界定其为领土外的军事力量时“军力”更精确，而与 Prosperity 并列的家园数值可按既有审校保留“权势”。这些细分基于各出处解释，应维持用途差异。
resolution.source_excerpt: These icons show your Prosperity and your Power. Most Homestead upgrades provide bonuses to one or the other. Some of the decisions you make in the story will also modify these values.

resolution.reason: Palisades 指防御用栅墙，中文“木栅墙”自然涵盖复数用法；另一条“栅墙”在特定句中可理解，但标准译名应保留木制防御设施信息。
resolution.source_excerpt: Well... you need to take the town. Find a way to punch through those palisades, then beat Aiblinn and her people.

terms.note: 此处作为战斗能力名称，描述会施加状态效果。

resolution.source_excerpt: What if I were to get a hold of some poison?

resolution.reason: Christians 在这些句子中指基督教信徒或群体，核心译名“基督徒”准确；种族、组织、身份等分类反映不同上下文，不构成译名冲突。

resolution.reason: Christian 指信奉基督教的人时译为“基督徒”；在 Christian country 与 Christian god 中作定语时译为“基督教”或“基督教的”也各自符合语法语境，因此保留这些有上下文依据的译法，不强行合并。
resolution.source_excerpt: Had you been a chieftain in a Christian country, you would not be a warrior.

resolution.source_excerpt: The cleric counts quietly on his fingers for a few moments.

resolution.source_excerpt: at Iona

resolution.source_excerpt: The Underground Ones keep them.

resolution.source_excerpt: Do you consider yourself capable of defending the fjord?

resolution.source_excerpt: the Mercians.

resolution.source_excerpt: Renounce your false gods and let yourselves be embraced by the light and love of our lord and saviour Jesus Christ!

resolution.source_excerpt: And far to the north, in the capital of the Picts, my Bear still has Woden's Horn, that I bestowed upon him before I knew his cruelty.

resolution.reason: 两处都将 Scouting 用作侦察行动/能力，译为“侦察”一致；技能与活动标签的分类差异不改变译名含义。
